referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Raw materials including syngas, processing energy, estimate on catalyst use based on "methanol from natural gas", emissions to air and water from process, plant infrastructure.
referenceFunction.localName: Methanol, from synthetic gas, at plant
referenceFunction.name: Methanol, from synthetic gas, at plant

geography.text: Data from few literature sources, largely based on methanol from natural gas.

technology.text: Data refers to full-methanol steam reforming (as opposed to autothermal reforming) of syngas derived from biomass gasification.

timePeriod.text: Data from 1995 to 2004, pilot scale, future technology

representativeness.productionVolume: No commercial plant of methanol-from-biomass. Laboratory-to-pilot scale.
representativeness.samplingProcedure: Production assessed with mixed data from literature and the ecoinvent 'methanol from natural gas' process. Data is considered relatively weak, as there is no commercial experience of methanol from bio-syngas. Representativity of the data seems difficult to assess.
